items.title: Meta Ads 2026-10-15: $47.14 spend, 0 leads
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign that spent: $47.14 on 1,435 impressions and 31 clicks, with no leads recorded. The 7-day baseline is 15 leads at about $22.73 CPL on $340.98, so this was a lead-less day on a below-budget ($50) spend, under the $50 anomaly threshold.
